entry.title: Hunter Schafer's hardest Blade Runner 2099 stunt 🥊

media:group.media:title: Hunter Schafer's hardest Blade Runner 2099 stunt 🥊
media:group.media:description:
What was the hardest stunt Hunter Schafer did for Blade Runner 2099? A long, fully choreographed fight in the first episode that took more than a day to shoot, and left her feeling the most physically wrecked of anything on set 🥊 Her takeaway: you learn the choreography, then you make it look a little messy. Her character isn't a trained fighter and mostly takes a beating, so there's an art to letting it get scrappy.
From ELLE's Ask Me Anything with Hunter Schafer. Watch the full episode on the ELLE channel.

media:group.media:title: Kristen Bell, Justine Lupe & Jackie Tohn Take Turns in the Hot Seat | Where Is the Lie? | ELLE
media:group.media:description:
Kristen Bell, Justine Lupe, and Jackie Tohn may be as close as family, but they still have plenty left to learn in this episode of “Where Is the Lie?”. The ‘Nobody Wants This’ co-stars attempt to out-bluff each other with stories about harboring a dead hamster for a week, passing out in front of Kurt Russell, and a surprising taste for Pepto-Bismol. Watch as Kristen defends her fear of puppets, Justine recalls singing “Papa Don’t Preach” at a staff event for her mom, and Jackie explains her unusual system for saving condom wrappers. Just when they think they have each other figured out, one tiny detail can change everything.
Stream ‘Nobody Wants This’ on Netflix.

entry.title: Why Alexander Skarsgård warns against dating his characters

media:group.media:title: Why Alexander Skarsgård warns against dating his characters
media:group.media:description:
Olivia Colman and Alexander Skarsgård let ELLE ask them anything in this episode of “Ask Me Anything.” The stars of ‘Wicker’ open up about the full-body transformation behind the wicker husband, Alexander’s most-quoted line from ‘Zoolander’ (orange mocha frappuccino!), and which of his characters from ‘The Northman’, ‘Big Little Lies’, and ‘On Becoming a God in Central Florida’ would make the best partner. Olivia shares her favorite costumes from ‘The Crown’, her nerves before walking the Miu Miu show, and her very strong opinions on tea, while Alexander explains Swedish Midsummer traditions. Plus, the pair reveal the last people who left them starstruck, from Elton John to Brad Pitt.
‘Wicker’ is in select theaters now and everywhere October 30.
